## 2. Feedback on Analysis and Formatting

- I had no source of reference to verify what was produced in this case, I only had the script and the data files. For all scripts/quarto documents, there is a need to submit results along with scripts for QC not just the script and hoping that it will work exactly the same for different people. We need a single source to verify what the person quality controlling is getting on their device when the scripts are rerun.

Solution: Going forward, author(s) of the scripts must render and export as pdf for original results and findings. This must be saved and provided as supplementary document to the QC panel for verification purposes. It can be in an email.

ACTION: The final rendered quarto document following QC process to be uploaded on the shared drive.

- The current file names are unnecessarily long and doesn't add anything valuable e.g. "comprehensive_analysis" or "Differential_Item_F\_...\_Analysis"

ACTION: Please consider renaming the quarto documents used to something that follows the naming convention agreed in our ways of working. e.g. "YYYY_MM_DD_TESTNAMEABBREVIATION_ANALYSISNAME.qmd"

- In their current version, there is lack of adequate information on different sections or comments on different code chunks, providing the necessary context.

ACTION: Each section and subsection should be clearly labelled and concisely named. The rationale of different datasets loaded in needs to be added as comments to provide context. Concise explanation of the specific data manipulation method used or analytic approach chosen to be provided for each code chunk. Full reliance on AI generated comments within the code chunks does not make it relevant or applicable to this test, data set, or this particular cycle of maintenance. Decisions from an analysis needs to be mentioned, even if concisely, whereas elaborate discussion can be saved for the report.
